title: 目標達成の後に・“三強”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky and I have had a fairly comfortable junior year…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But soon after, she's approached by King Halo and Special Week, both bringing declarations of war.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Grass Wonder and El Condor Pasa have chosen a different path, Seiun Sky's immediate rivals are narrowed down to these two.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So Seiun Sky finally starts taking serious action. Our next goal is the first race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.
